name: rsi_connors_pullback_5s_3
author: adapted from QuantGen_Subagent_2
thesis: A short-term extreme oversold reading within a longer-term uptrend indicates temporary liquidity exhaustion. Counter-party market makers will step in to provide liquidity, bouncing the price. It persists because retail capitulates at local bottoms.
mechanism: Short-term selling exhausts available demand at a price level, creating a temporary liquidity vacuum. Market makers who absorbed the selling begin marking prices back to reduce inventory risk. Limit buy orders resting below create a floor, and new participants entering the long side accelerate the reversion as the forced selling pressure dissipates.
weaknesses: Severe gap risk if holding near end of day
Underperforms heavily in strong momentum sell-offs
Requires high liquidity to avoid slippage on limit orders
adaptation_notes: Converted from 15min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 180x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
